# Week 1

## Video 1

### 介绍练习

```{R}
library(UsingR)
data("father.son", package = "UsingR")
head(father.son)
mean(father.son$sheight)
```

```{R}
data("father.son", package = "UsingR")

# 筛选父亲身高四舍五入后等于71英寸的儿子身高
son_heights <- father.son$sheight[
  round(father.son$fheight) == 71
]

# 查看筛选后的身高列表
print(son_heights)

# 计算平均身高
print(mean(son_heights))
```

## Video 3

```python
import sympy as sp

# 系数矩阵 A
A = sp.Matrix([
    [1, 1, 1],
    [3, -2, 1],
    [2, 1, -1],
])

# 右侧列向量 b
b = sp.Matrix([6, 2, 1])

# 表达式 A^{-1} b
expr = A.inv() * b

# 打印
sp.pprint(A)
sp.pprint(b)
sp.pprint(expr)
```

```{R}
X <- matrix(1:12, 4, 3)
print(X)

a <- 2
print(a * X)
```

```{R}
X <- matrix(c(1, 3, 2, 1, -2, 1, 1, 1, -1), 3, 3)
beta <- c(3, 2, 1)
X %*% beta # 矩阵乘法
```

```{R}
X <- matrix(c(1, 3, 2, 1, -2, 1, 1, 1, -1), 3, 3)
y <- matrix(c(6, 2, 1), 3, 1)
solve(X) %*% y # 等价于 solve(X,y)
solve(X, y)
qr(X)
```

```{R}
q <- qr.Q(qr(X))
crossprod(q[, 1], q[, 2])
isTRUE(all.equal(
  as.numeric(crossprod(q[, 1], q[, 2])),
  0
))
# TRUE
```

#### 2

```{R}
A <- matrix(
  c(
    3, 2, 1, 5,
    4, 2, -1, 0,
    -5, 2, 5, 0,
    1, -1, -5, 1
  ),
  nrow = 4, ncol = 4
)
b <- matrix(c(10, 5, 7, 4), 4, 1)
solve(A, b)
```
